before_results.readmission: The positive class is readmission within 30 days. A missed positive matters more because the patient may not be flagged for added discharge planning or follow-up; a false alarm may use resources for someone who would not be readmitted.
before_results.diabetes: The positive class is doctor diagnosis or HbA1c at least 6.5%. A missed positive matters more because the person may not be flagged for follow-up testing; a false alarm may lead to an unnecessary follow-up test.
